GateSpec.description:
One gate declared inside a MandateSpec@v0.

Sub-shape of MandateSpec@v0 · lives inline (Critic-pass ManifestEntry
precedent · same substructure discipline as PJManifestEntry /
TPManifestEntry / FRManifestEntry).

condition_expr.description: Boolean condition (structured expression) that the generated gate enforces.
condition_expr.title: Condition Expr

gate_id.description: Deterministic gate identifier · derived from mandate source line-anchor.
gate_id.title: Gate Id

gate_kind.description: A3.4 Rules Taxonomy class of the gate this spec generates (S/O/E/D via label).
gate_kind.title: Gate Kind

refusal_reason.description: Refusal reason (PROM-S1-refusal-taxonomy-closed compatible) emitted on gate fire.
refusal_reason.title: Refusal Reason

source_line_anchor.description: Verbatim line-anchor citation in the source mandate document.
source_line_anchor.title: Source Line Anchor

GateSpec.title: GateSpec

description:
MandateSpec@v0 · structured spec derived from a mandate document.

Persisted output written to `docs/generated/mandate_specs/<spec_id>.yaml`
by `backend/services/far_endpoint/mandate_spec_emitter.py`.
Consumed by `backend/services/far_endpoint/gate_generator.py` to
emit executable gate functions at `backend/services/generated_gates/`.

D-11 round-trip discipline (Owner ruling verbatim): *"an enforcement
chain of mandate → spec → gate is only auditable if the middle link
is a persisted, SHA-verifiable artifact"*.

gates.description: Enumerated GateSpec entries · one per identified gate in source mandate.
gates.title: Gates

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at emitter invocation.
generated_at.title: Generated At

generator_version.description: Version pin of the emitter that produced this spec · pinned per engine version per A3.4 Class E discipline.
generator_version.title: Generator Version

source_mandate_path.description: Relative path to source mandate document (repo-root-relative).
source_mandate_path.title: Source Mandate Path

source_mandate_sha_256.description: SHA-256 (64-hex) of source mandate at emission time.
source_mandate_sha_256.title: Source Mandate Sha 256

spec_id.description: Deterministic spec identifier · derived from source mandate filename stem.
spec_id.title: Spec Id

title: MandateSpec_v0
